qualitative_review: Direct scope test of the S6-S9 fork on pre-modern instruments never pre-sorted by modern standards; pre-declared recurrence thresholds make either outcome informative.
uncertainties: Co-occurrence is partly predictable from diplomatics; linguistic coverage and translation blur could force a smaller or messier sample.

qualitative_review: Converts the repo's admitted no-kappa gap into per-slot agreement; disagreement localises which slots every headline figure rests on, within the sole-researcher constraint.
uncertainties: Gloss-blind tagging may fail on Arabic/Thai/Han rows; kappa measures agreement not validity, so gain depends on how disagreements are adjudicated.

qualitative_review: Stress-tests the clearest single structural finding at document scale with real denominators; measured co-occurrence rates could dissolve or harden the fork.
uncertainties: Corpus licence and OCR quality unknown; detection failure in two or more script families would leave the claim untested rather than refuted.

qualitative_review: Mechanical verbatim quote-matching plus entailment closes the semantic gap in the citation gate; tiny spend and a hand-checked subsample make it quickly decisive.
uncertainties: Cross-lingual entailment on cheap models unverified; interpretive claims may legitimately return partial, blurring the flag threshold.

qualitative_review: First quantitative per-slot functional-value profile via ablation with sham controls; tests whether the universal stem is load-bearing or descriptive baggage.
uncertainties: Template-instantiated ablated texts may lack ecological validity; layout-only slots are untestable in plain text and must be declared out of scope.

qualitative_review: Adds a registered processing-cost outcome so the register question stays answerable under the accuracy ceiling; most timing machinery already exists in the instrument.
uncertainties: Browser RT granularity unverified; ethics review for the human version gates the confirmatory run and may push work beyond the 1-3 month window.

qualitative_review: Turns the repo's unmeasured efficiency claim into entropy and redundancy numbers on frozen data in days; permutation nulls make an honest null result informative.
uncertainties: Mutual-information estimators are biased at n=25; if permutation nulls swallow every effect the metric has no signal at this sample size.

qualitative_review: Edition-diffing yields a true within-standard time series, separating real identifier accretion in standardisers' decisions from era-bin composition in the modernity trend.
uncertainties: Superseded editions are often paywalled or mirrored unreliably; fewer than three retrievable editions per standard makes the series anecdotal.

qualitative_review: Single-system before/after test of the claim that medium moves slots into infrastructure, on a dated Ukrainian reform lineage with slot invariance vs carrier shift pre-stated.
uncertainties: Older Ukrainian and Soviet texts may be unobtainable; one trajectory is a mechanism case, not an effect estimate, so inference stays narrow.

qualitative_review: Adds a citizen-vs-administration column giving a grammar-based burden count for one service each in UA, EE and DE - a novel policy quantity, explicitly framed as a pilot.
uncertainties: Portal geo-restrictions and non-equivalent entitlements may collapse the comparison; one service per country limits discriminatory power.

qualitative_review: Measures reliability once across all four hand-coded layers and propagates measured error into every headline figure; flips beyond 5 percent would bound the whole atlas.
uncertainties: An LLM coder is not a human rater, so machine-human kappa may not bound human-human kappa; deliverable may collapse into the planned two-coder pass.

qualitative_review: Exact enumeration regrades the formal negation from census fact to population inference; the worked p about 0.45 example already shows the single edge is weak alone.
uncertainties: Conclusions hinge on null choice, independent vs tradition-blocked; at n=25 the enumeration sets a p-value floor, so the null must be pre-specified.

qualitative_review: Puts headline finding 3 into a pre-stated variance partition with intervals; tradition matching or beating genre would force a rewrite of the README headline claim.
uncertainties: A genre column must be hand-coded for about 56 rows, re-importing single-coder judgement; roughly 28 units give a coarse permutation distribution.

qualitative_review: Recasts universality as intervals over a disclosed sampling frame plus a committed pre-coded hold-out score - the atlas's first genuine out-of-sample test of the grammar.
uncertainties: Any sampling frame is contestable; the prospective arm needs one uncoded system whose retrieval (RU or Central Asia) may fail.

qualitative_review: Shows the 10 pp SESOI becomes unattainable at ceiling baselines and calibrates items on an expanded machine panel pre-recruitment - cheap insurance for the human arm.
uncertainties: Machine-to-human difficulty invariance is untested and load-bearing; model-family correlation may leave too little effective n for stable calibration.

qualitative_review: Codes the record-life layer for all 28 systems so persistence/appraisal stops being a one-case aside; orthogonality of the kinds-of-document-law catalogue becomes testable.
uncertainties: Retention evidence in existing case files may be thin; more than a third not-found would demote the layer to a documented gap rather than a variable.

qualitative_review: Classifies all 225 requisites by migration behaviour to test that morphology survives while carriers do not - a preservation-risk profile nothing in the repo measures.
uncertainties: Only a delayed self-recode checks the rubric, no inter-rater check possible solo; English glosses may already have erased substrate cues from local_term.

qualitative_review: Freezes the disclosed grounding tiers and retests the fork, stem membership and S12 on strong-primary systems only - cheap, gate-compatible robustness or scope-bound result.
uncertainties: The usable subset may fall to 8-10 systems; exact counts with wide-open uncertainty must not be sold as confirmation.

qualitative_review: Converts the scoped boundary from assertion into test by recoding khipu and wampum, plus a third non-documentary system, with a medium-neutral record grammar.
uncertainties: Both boundary cases rest on encyclopedia-grade sources; failure to fill abstract slots would be absence-of-evidence, not a demonstrated boundary.

qualitative_review: Tests whether stewardship adds a fourth regime dimension in which the legislator is not the state - a genuine de-centring, decided by a residual-clause test.
uncertainties: Framework existence and retrievability unverified this round; extractive coding without engagement risks the very critique the idea targets.

qualitative_review: Adds a colonial-genealogy column and permutation test of metropole-successor affinity, converting the narrative imperial-continuity theme into a falsifiable structural claim.
uncertainties: Metropole profiles for GB, PT and BE are absent, so 2-4 new case files are needed; thin African coding and sparse-system artefacts may swamp the signal.

qualitative_review: Tests whether inclusion and grounding tier track open-web retrievability - an availability-bias audit of the atlas's own breadth with a publishable null either way.
uncertainties: The external universe list is deferred to a later search round; a post-hoc retrievability proxy risks circularity unless frozen before analysis.

qualitative_review: Hunts a third deliberative-note declension whose profile (no S9, no S12, filled reference/subject) would make the famous negation a special case of a fuller paradigm.
uncertainties: Cross-linguistic genre ID rests on one functional definition at small n; the idea may die on the coverage gate (five systems) rather than on structure.
